The seven OSI layers

Read the networking function first, then consider which part of an AWS service performs a related function. Architecture tiers and OSI layers describe different things.

AWS managed services commonly span several protocols and layers. The associations below are a learning interpretation. Identity management, billing and deployment tools are cross-cutting control-plane capabilities.

Useful distinctions

Route 53 answers DNS queries. It does not forward the application’s IP packets. Application Load Balancers inspect HTTP requests; Network Load Balancers distribute transport connections.

Security groups and network ACLs inspect IP/protocol/port rules. They do not replace AWS WAF’s web-request rules.

Conceptual upper layers

Real TCP/IP stacks combine many session and presentation functions into applications and libraries. TLS sits above its transport rather than matching one OSI box perfectly.

ACM supplies certificates and KMS manages keys. Calling either product “the presentation layer” would hide the components that actually encrypt and exchange traffic.
